flow.menu.label: Main menu
flow.menu.newGameText: Your saved game will be replaced. Levels you have unlocked stay unlocked.
flow.lang.title: Language
flow.lang.note: The game show questions and the host's welcome are in every language. Everything else is in English for now.
flow.cutscene.chooseHintKeys: Click Amy or Harry, or pick with {key_left} {key_right} and press {key_confirm}
flow.cutscene.privacy: You don't have to fill this in. Your nickname stays on this device and is only used by the host. You can clear it in Settings.
flow.cutscene.closing: All right, {name}! Let's shrink you down and explore the weird world of microbes!
flow.cutscene.quitText: You will go back to the main menu.
flow.shrink.announce: The shrinking zone. You are being shrunk to the size of a microbe!
flow.summary.unlocked: The next level is open in Level select.
flow.ending.win: Well done! You beat {cpu}. Thank you for playing.
flow.ending.lose: At the end of the game, I'm sorry to say you lost. Thank you for playing.
flow.ending.draw: It's a draw! You and {cpu} have exactly the same score. Well done, both of you! Thank you for playing.
flow.ending.drawSub: Neck and neck to the very last question.
flow.ending.loseSub: Good try, {name}! Play again to beat them next time.
flow.ending.note: The winner is decided by quiz points.
flow.levels.title: Level select
flow.levels.locked: {title}. Locked: reach it in the game show to open it.
flow.settings.title: Settings
flow.settings.blindDesc: The host also asks each round's questions before the level, without telling you the answers, as in the 2009 classroom version.
flow.settings.restartRoundDesc: After losing a level, start again from the round's first level, as in 2009. Off: just try that level again.
flow.settings.languageDesc: Game show questions and the host's welcome.
flow.settings.reducedMotionDesc: Fewer moving effects. Auto follows your device.
flow.settings.reducedShakeDesc: Gentler shakes. Auto follows your device.
flow.settings.textSizeDesc: Bigger text in menus and speech boxes.
flow.settings.touchOpacityDesc: How solid the on-screen buttons look.
flow.settings.hapticsDesc: Buzz on bumps and big moments.
flow.settings.classicDone: Classic keys: Up jumps, Space throws, Ctrl takes photos.
flow.settings.remappedMoved: {key} now does {action}. It no longer does {from}.
flow.settings.clearNicknameText: The host will call you by your player's name instead.
flow.settings.resetProgressDesc: Forget the saved game, unlocked levels and best scores.
flow.settings.resetText: Your saved game, unlocked levels and best scores will be deleted. This can't be undone.
flow.settings.privacy: Everything is saved only in this browser. Nothing is sent anywhere.
